explain.say: Ask your grandparents what they watched as children. Maybe one TV channel, or none at all! Then ask what you watch. Look at the board: a timeline of generations. A generation is a group of people born around the same years, who grow up with similar events and technology.

faq.a: A generation is a group of people born in the same span of years, roughly 15 to 20 years, who grow up during similar events and with similar technology.
Baby Boomers were born from about 1946 to 1964, during the jump in births after World War Two. They grew up as TV spread into homes.
Millennials, also called Generation Y, were born from about 1981 to 1996. They became adults around the year 2000, the new millennium, as the internet and mobile phones spread.
Generation Z were born from about 1997 to 2012. Many had smartphones and social media from their teenage years or earlier, so they are often called digital natives.
Generation Alpha is the name for children born from about 2013 onwards. They are growing up with tablets, streaming, voice assistants and AI as everyday things.
asks: What generation is after Gen Z?

facts: The Pew Research Center defines Boomers as born 1946 to 1964, Gen X 1965 to 1980, Millennials 1981 to 1996 and Gen Z from 1997 to 2012.
Generation names and dates are rough and mostly come from US research; other countries may group generations differently.

quiz.why: Millennials were born from about 1981 to 1996, so 1990 fits.
